## Summary

Explain the user problem, the implemented behavior, and the affected Hawk surfaces.

## Verification

- [ ] npm test
- [ ] npm run typecheck
- [ ] npm run lint
- [ ] Relevant desktop or integration checks passed
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are attached for visible UI changes
- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated when required

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] The change respects explicit authorization boundaries
- [ ] Secrets and sensitive traffic are redacted
- [ ] Tool execution remains sandboxed or approval-gated
- [ ] Recovery, rollback, and failure behavior were considered
